1) 用 smartctl -a /dev/sdX 看完整属性，重点关注 Rea: 1) Run smartctl -a /dev/sdX for the full attribute list, focusing on Reallocated_Sector_Ct, Current_Pending_Sector and Offline_Uncorrectable; 2) Immediately confirm the data on this disk has a replica or backup — this is the highest priority action; 3) In a RAID array, check the array state and let it evict this disk and rebuild onto a hot spare; 4) Schedule downtime to replace the disk and stop writing to it.
1) 用 smartctl -a /dev/sdX 确认 Erase_Fail_: 1) Run smartctl -a /dev/sdX and check Erase_Fail_Count together with the remaining Reallocated/Available_Reservd_Space; 2) A shrinking spare block pool means the disk is near end of life — confirm the data has a replica immediately; 3) Schedule a replacement rather than waiting for writes to fail outright; 4) Reduce write pressure on the disk beforehand so it does not degrade faster.
1) 用 smartctl -a /dev/sdX 确认 Media_Wearo: 1) Run smartctl -a /dev/sdX and check Media_Wearout_Indicator / Percentage_Used together with Total_LBAs_Written; 2) Combine with the write rate to estimate remaining life and plan the replacement window; 3) Confirm the data on this disk has a replica and prepare the migration plan in advance; 4) Review the source of write amplification (log level, frequent small writes, no TRIM) so the replacement does not repeat it.
1) 用 smartctl -a /dev/sdX 确认 Program_Fai: 1) Run smartctl -a /dev/sdX and check Program_Fail_Count together with the remaining spare block ratio; 2) Immediately confirm the data on this disk has a replica or backup — this is the highest priority action; 3) Schedule a replacement soon: program failures often come with a risk of silent data corruption; 4) Before replacing it, make the disk read-only or move hot data off to stop further writes.
1) 用 smartctl -a /dev/sdX 确认 UDMA_CRC_Er: 1) Run smartctl -a /dev/sdX and check how fast UDMA_CRC_Error_Count is growing; 2) Take the machine down, reseat the SATA/SAS data and power cables, and preferably just replace the cable; 3) After replacing the cable, watch whether the counter stops growing — SMART counters never reset, so judge by the delta, not the absolute value; 4) If a new cable does not help, suspect the backplane or HBA and swap them one at a time.
1) 用 smartctl -a /dev/sdX 确认温度与厂商标称的工作温度: 1) Run smartctl -a /dev/sdX and compare the temperature against the vendor's rated maximum; 2) Check chassis airflow, fan speeds and dust in the filters, plus the room's ambient temperature; 3) Check whether the bay layout is too dense and whether neighbouring disks are equally hot; 4) Short term, reduce IO pressure on this disk (shift backups off peak, move hot data) to buy time.
CRC错误计数1小时内持续增长: CRC error count keeps growing within 1 hour
SSD 擦除操作失败计数在增长，闪存块正在损坏，可用容量会持续下降并最终导致写入: The SSD's erase failure count is growing: flash blocks are failing, usable capacity will keep shrinking and writes will eventually fail.
SSD 的介质磨损度已达 90%，写入寿命接近耗尽，达到 100% 后可能转为只: The SSD's media wear indicator has reached 90%: write endurance is nearly exhausted, and at 100% it may go read-only or fail outright.
SSD 编程（写入）失败计数在增长，闪存单元正在失效，写入可靠性已经无法保证。: The SSD's program (write) failure count is growing: flash cells are failing and write reliability can no longer be guaranteed.
SSD闪存块写入失败，闪存芯片健康度急剧下降，需立即备份数据: SSD flash block program failures; flash chip health is degrading rapidly, back up data immediately
SSD闪存块擦除失败，意味着闪存芯片老化，存在数据写入故障风险: SSD flash block erase failures indicate aging flash chips and a risk of write failures
SSD闪存芯片磨损程度接近耗尽，随时可能发生故障，需立即备份数据并更换硬盘: SSD flash wearout is nearly exhausted and may fail at any time; back up data and replace the drive immediately
数据传输链路CRC校验失败次数增加，可能是接口、线缆或硬盘控制器故障前兆: Growing CRC failures on the data link, a possible precursor of interface, cable or disk controller failure
硬盘温度超过 65℃，长期高温会显著加速磁盘老化并提高故障率，SSD 还可能触发: Disk temperature is above 65°C. Sustained heat significantly accelerates ageing and raises the failure rate, and SSDs may also throttle.
硬盘自身检测的整体健康状态为不健康，存在严重故障风险，需立即处理: Disk self-assessed overall health is FAILED, serious failure risk, handle immediately
硬盘运行温度过高，会加速硬件老化甚至导致直接故障，需立即检查散热: Disk operating temperature too high, which accelerates aging or causes outright failure; check cooling immediately
磁盘接口 CRC 错误持续增长，这通常不是盘体问题而是数据线或接口接触不良，会导: Disk interface CRC errors keep growing. This is usually not the drive itself but a bad data cable or connector; it causes read/write retries and degraded performance, and over time can corrupt data.
磁盘的 SMART 自检整体健康状态为不通过，硬盘随时可能彻底失效，上面的数据有: The disk's overall SMART health self-assessment has failed. The drive can fail completely at any moment and the data on it is at risk.
